user_saw: With strict browser SSRF policy enabled, an existing-session Chrome profile could follow a redirect before OpenClaw checked the destination.
summary: The browser plugin now rejects HTTP(S) navigation and tab opens through Chrome MCP when strict SSRF policy requires redirect inspection.
reasoning: At the earliest locally readable revision, both Chrome MCP paths already dispatched after checking the initial URL and validated the final URL only afterward, while raw CDP tab opens already had a strict redirect-inspection gate. The older path history stopped at a missing commit object, so I could not verify whether the defect shipped with Chrome MCP or was introduced by a later change.
